# SteamCMD

The generic SteamCMD egg for any game with an app id: 1 egg.
Back to [all eggs](../README.md#steamcmd).

| Game | Egg | Runtime images | Extra ports | Tested | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Generic SteamCMD game | [generic.json](generic.json) | [`steamcmd_debian`](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-yolks#steamcmd_debian) [`proton`](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-yolks#proton) | – | [—](../TESTED.md#steamcmd-generic) | sleep (udp), Proton |

Extra ports are the ports Octail assigns next to the primary one (`+1` = primary port + 1). Notes: RCON (and its protocol), the Players tab or a player count, idle sleep (wake on connect), Wine/Proton and other things to know.

Tested: the last real run of the egg on one of our nodes with the image it ships (install, ready line or bound port, a console command, stop): ✓ passed, ✗ failed, — not run on these images yet. Details in [TESTED.md](../TESTED.md).

## Importing this folder

```bash
octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/steamcmd
```

Or in the panel: Admin → Eggs → Import eggs → **GitHub** with `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/steamcmd`. One
egg: its raw address, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/steamcmd/<egg>.json`.

Something wrong with one of these eggs? [Open an issue](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/issues/new/choose).
